From the Principal's Desk
Dr. Ranjan Kalita
Principal (i/c) & Secretary
Dear Students, it is with great pleasure that I welcome you to Govt. Model College, a newly established institution committed to providing you with a holistic and enriching educational experience. Our college, located in the serene surroundings of Balipara, Sonitpur district, was established by the Government of Assam with the aim of offering high-quality higher education to students like you.
Read Full Message
Call the Office
7002355539
Welcome to Govt. Model College, Balipara
Govt. Model College is a recently established degree college located in Balipara, Sonitpur district, Assam, founded by the Government of Assam to cater to the educational needs of the region. The college is situated in a picturesque location, providing a serene and conducive environment for learning.
Vision
To be a premier educational institution known for excellence in teaching, research and community engagement, where students, faculty and staff are inspired to achieve their full potential.
Mission
To provide accessible, affordable and quality higher education to Balipara and beyond, and to nurture skilled, knowledgeable and responsible citizens.
